# <span id="aanchor152"></span> Location Validations

Location validations allow you to validate that certain values (such as gas volume, energy, mass, and GSV) fall within the set points that you specify.

<div class="procedure">

To specify minimum and maximum set points for location validations: 

In the Location Editor, select **Tools** \> **Validations**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 548;height: 465;" />

</div>

After you specify minimum and maximum values, FLOWCAL prompts you to specify a time range and run validations. If a value is above or below the set points that you specified, FLOWCAL generates an exception.

The Location Rollup service automatically runs validations. You can also initiate them from the Toolbox (**Tools** \> **Toolbox**).

For all location types, FLOWCAL validates the net quantity in the given unit and does not perform unit conversions. For balance locations, FLOWCAL also validates the calculated percent difference:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 561;height: 474;" />

GSV, NSV, Summed Volume, and Net Allowable are only available with the **Liquids** module.
